blocks.en: Apply harakah where required, write the analysis (Tarkeeb) inc BTM and translation for the following Sentences.
Obedience is that you worship Allah.

blocks.ar: يحبُّ زيد {{term|أن}} يُكمِل عمله إلى آخره
blocks.en: Zayd loves to finish his work to its end.
I keep to my duties so that I am not blamed.
I longed to meet Zayd because he is generous.
That you study leads to your succeeding.
It grieves me that you should go off with him.
They dispute with you about the truth after it has become clear.

blocks.ar: يطلب الأستاذ {{term|أن}} تنتبهوا في دروسكم ما عَلّمكم
blocks.en: The teacher asks that you pay attention in your lessons to what he taught you.
